sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Adriesta is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. She is a a member of the Imperial Academy and the youngest member to attain the rank of "Master Witch Hunter".

sections.title: Debut Appearance
sections.content: Adriesta first appears in Raid X5, receiving aid from the Summoner to fight Kielazar.

sections.title: History
sections.content:
Adriesta was an orphan who was taken in and raised by the Imperial Academy. She quickly rose in rank thanks to her skills and talents in witch-hunting arts. Later in her life, Adriesta married a man from distinguished family and eventually resigned her position in order to raise a son with him.

However, at some point after giving birth to their son, her husband and associates were killed by an an unknown force, Adriesta's memories were sealed, and her child was taken away from her. After awakening from her slumber, she found herself on the shore of Fuindor, the Cursed Island. Unable to pass on due to the Fuinsignum on her body and holding onto the hope that her child is still alive, she journeyed upon the island to search for clue.
